text: With m2 fixed, N=128 force margins sit just under the 0.1 bar on both datasets (here 0.092 and 0.0999, still rising about 0.002-0.006 per 500 steps), while the N=64 controls and N=128 controls agree within 0.015 at layer 4. Is the m2-fixed N=64 to N=128 force loss always in trained R2 and never in the control? Pooling all four m2-fixed seed-dataset pairs at a fixed layer would test whether the control term is always within ±0.02.
